actions: Search for oak trees in the surrounding area within a reasonable range.
Approach the nearest oak tree.
Break 7 oak log blocks using your hand.
Collect all dropped oak logs until you have 7 in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 oak_log.
Craft 12 oak planks using the oak logs in your inventory.
Craft 1 crafting_table using 4 oak_planks from your inventory.
Craft 4 sticks using 2 oak planks at the crafting table.
Craft another 4 sticks using 2 oak planks at the crafting table.
Craft 1 stick using 1 oak plank at the crafting table.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 9 sticks.
Place the crafting_table on the ground.
Craft 3 oak_planks from the available oak_log.
Craft 2 sticks from the available oak_planks.
Craft 1 wooden_pickaxe using the 3 oak_planks and 2 sticks in the crafting_table.
Locate a stone deposit in the current area.
Use the wooden pickaxe to mine 11 stone blocks.
Collect all dropped cobblestone until you have 11 in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 11 cobblestone.
Use the crafting table to craft 1 stone_pickaxe.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 stone_pickaxe.
Search for coal ore within a reasonable range of 32 blocks.
Mine the first coal ore block using the wooden pickaxe.
Mine the second coal ore block using the wooden pickaxe.
Mine the third coal ore block using the wooden pickaxe.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 3 coal.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 furnace using 8 cobblestone from your inventory.
Search for iron ore within a 128 block radius.
Mine 7 iron ore blocks using the stone pickaxe.
Collect all dropped raw iron until you have 7 in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 raw_iron.
Use the furnace in your inventory.
Place the raw_iron into the furnace.
Add coal to the furnace as fuel.
Smelt the raw_iron until you obtain iron_ingot.
Repeat the smelting process until you have 7 iron_ingots.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 iron_ingots.
Craft 1 iron_pickaxe using the crafting_table.
Use 3 iron_ingots from your inventory.
Use 2 sticks from your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 iron_pickaxe.
Use the crafting_table in your inventory.
Craft 1 bucket using 3 iron_ingots from your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 bucket.
Search for diamond ore within a range of 128 blocks.
Collect 29 diamond ore blocks using the iron pickaxe.
Search for gravel blocks in the nearby area within a range of 64 blocks.
Collect 1 gravel block using the iron pickaxe.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 gravel.
Use the crafting table to craft the gravel into flint.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 flint.
Use the bucket from your inventory.
Search for a nearby water source within 32 blocks.
Go to the water source.
Use the bucket on the water source to fill it with water.
Use the crafting_table to craft 2 sticks from the available wood resources.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 diamond_pickaxe using 3 diamonds and 2 sticks.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 diamond_pickaxe.
Craft 1 flint_and_steel using 1 iron_ingot and 1 flint.
Locate a water source nearby.
Use the bucket to collect water from the water source.
Search for a lava pool in the vicinity.
If a lava pool is found, place the water bucket on top of the lava to create obsidian.
Use the diamond pickaxe to mine the obsidian block.
Collect the mined obsidian.
Repeat the mining process until you have a total of 10 obsidian blocks.
Collect 4 diamond from your inventory.
Craft 1 diamond_boots using the crafting_table in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 diamond_boots.
Craft 1 diamond_leggings using the crafting_table.
Open the crafting interface.
Place 7 diamonds in the crafting grid.
Collect the diamond_leggings from the crafting result.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 diamond_chestplate using 8 diamonds.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 diamond_helmet using 5 diamonds.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 diamond_sword.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 diamond_sword.
Build a nether portal using 10 obsidian blocks.
Use flint_and_steel to ignite the portal.
Use the nether_portal to enter the Nether.
Locate a blaze in the Nether.
Approach the blaze and engage in combat.
Attack the blaze until it is defeated and drops a blaze_rod.
Collect the blaze_rod from the ground.
Craft 1 blaze_powder using the 1 blaze_rod in your crafting_table.
Search for an enderman in the nearby area using a search range of 128 blocks.
Approach the enderman cautiously to avoid aggroing other entities.
Equip the diamond sword from your inventory.
Attack the enderman until it is defeated.
Collect the ender pearl dropped by the enderman.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 ender_pearl.
Use the crafting table to craft 1 ender_eye using 1 ender_pearl and 1 blaze_powder from your inventory.
